title: NewEra — Make the idea real
music: Life Force — supplied MP3; full track, no trim

design.type: DejaVu Sans bold display with DejaVu Sans Mono telemetry; tight but legible tracking
design.motion: ease-out cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) for arrivals; symmetric quintic smoothstep for continuous camera drift; no linear position animation
layers: small corner telemetry and restrained waveform

timing_policy: Scene boundaries are quantized to the nearest detected onset frame from beat_map.json. Short punctuation cuts use measured band peaks/onsets; keep typography readable by consolidating minor transients into one hold rather than flashing on every onset.

acts.name: The spark / old paradigm
acts.music_cues: opening plucks, detected onset grid; verify actual drum entry by listening
acts.visuals: One mint point breathes in an obsidian field. A horizontal axis draws, then vertical axis locks, bounding geometry closes; restrained microcopy asks for more than a prompt. ‘A prompt starts it.’ / ‘An agent carries it through.’ Contrast is conceptual, not a straw-man product comparison.
acts.transitions: plucks construct axis → frame → word; deep points scale the core via eased spring without strobe

acts.name: The first arrival — NewEra
acts.music_cues: high-energy region around 15–30 s in 5 s RMS/mid/high-band summaries
acts.visuals: A sharp white inversion on a measured low-band peak, immediately back to obsidian. A mint line folds into the NewEra wordmark; modular tiles resolve around it. Product promise: free, online, autonomous AI coding agent. One brief UI command card appears; no invented benchmark or latency metric.
acts.transitions: white flash capped to 2 frames at 60 fps, masked geometric match cut; cubic ease-out scale settle
copy: From an idea to a working app.

acts.name: Autonomous execution
acts.music_cues: beat grid; recurring sub/mid/high band local maxima from beat_map
acts.visuals: Command input becomes a plan: describe → plan → files → build → fix. A node graph branches into parallel roles, then reconverges at green checks. The web surface and terminal-inspired panels are original graphic abstractions; consent is indicated before GitHub push. Deployment resolves into Cloudflare Pages / EdgeOne chips as supported by the site brief.
acts.transitions: cursor path magnetically snaps to active nodes; button-border zoom match-cut into the next workspace; beat cuts are selected from actual onset event frames, not every transient

acts.name: The work becomes a system
acts.music_cues: mid-track rhythmic continuity; high-band peaks punctuate telemetry and selected transitions
acts.visuals: Bento windows of planning, code, browser and build checks open one at a time, then connect. Oversized kinetic words — ‘THINK’, ‘MAKE’, ‘SHIP’ — alternate with a sparse node core. Technical corner labels show stages only, not fake live performance values. Dark/light reversals are limited to clearly salient audio events.
acts.transitions: 90-degree wireframe square flattens into four-panel system map; type hits on selected onset frames and eases through every approach/settle

acts.name: Resolution — your next era
acts.music_cues: final detected beat grid and natural soundtrack ending; preserve the actual outro, no artificial early fade
acts.visuals: Panels fold toward one mint core. Acceleration falls away; sparse field and a single resolving outline. NewEra AI Agent wordmark, newera.namansoni.in and ‘Built by Naman Soni’ hold in a calm, generous final card. Close on the track’s real final decay.
acts.transitions: ease-out cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); no hard black between scenes; logo and URL remain legible through audio end

honesty_guardrails: Do not imply that the video renderer is the NewEra product UI.
No fabricated speed, adoption, customer, benchmark or accuracy claims.
No Manus logos/assets/copy in final film.
Frequency band analysis is full-mix proxy energy, not source-separated instruments.
